rows.item: Shenzhou 1 return capsule (神舟一号返回舱)
rows.notes: CSTM's own Oct 2025 activity page names the Shenzhou-1 return capsule (and the YF-77 engine) as exhibits introduced to the public; zh.wikipedia 神舟一号 says the capsule is held by 中国科技馆; photographed June 2023 (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shenzhou-1_return_capsule_at_CSTM_01.jpg). The museum page does not use the word 实物; Shenzhou 1 was an uncrewed 1999 flight.

CSTM page names a YF-77 engine as an exhibit; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YF-77_at_CSTM.jpg. Neither source says whether it is a real flight-standard/test engine or a display model; kind is a guess.

rows.item: Tianhe core module structural verification unit (天和核心舱结构验证件)
rows.notes: Museum wording is 结构验证件 (structural verification article). Commons files call the same object a 'Tianhe core module mockup' (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:China_Science_and_Technology_Museum), so real vs full-scale model is unresolved. Same item as in out2_A_zh_1.

rows.item: Shenzhou 5 return capsule (神舟五号返回舱), Yang Liwei's flight
rows.notes: zh.wikipedia: 神舟五号返回舱现藏于中国国家博物馆, shown in the permanent 复兴之路 exhibition; photo dated 2023-06-22 (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shenzhou-5_return_capsule_at_NMC.jpg). chnmuseum.cn homepage fetch did not show the item, so no museum-own page; Wikipedia/Commons only. Same museum also showed Shenzhou-13 return capsule and parachute, and YF-20/YF-100/YF-77 engines in the temporary exhibition 逐梦寰宇问苍穹——中国载人航天工程三十年成就展 (opened 2023-02; photographed 2023-06): temporary, status unknown, not recorded as rows.

rows.item: Shenzhou 4 return capsule (神舟四号返回舱实物)
rows.notes: zh.wikipedia lists 神舟四号返回舱实物 among the modern-hall exhibits, but also says the museum relocated around 2022; zh.wikipedia 神舟四号 shows the capsule and parachute at Guangdong Science Center in Sept 2021 (a loan). The museum site casc-spacemuseum.com has an expired certificate and could not be read. Current location not confirmed.

rows.item: Shenzhou 6 return capsule (神舟六号载人航天飞船返回舱)
rows.notes: zh.wikipedia: at opening (12 June 2010) the 2850-piece collection included the Shenzhou 6 return capsule and the recovery/medical equipment used for Yang Liwei's return. Museum in Qiaonan Town, Linwei District, Weinan, Shaanxi. Wikipedia only, no current-display source read.
